title.ko: 비인칭 수동: It is said that · is believed to · is thought to have
title.en: impersonal passives: it is said that, is believed to, is thought to have + past participle

explain.ko: 비인칭 수동은 사람이 아닌 일반적인 견해나 소문을 객관적으로 전할 때 씁니다. It is said/believed/thought/reported that + 절의 형태가 있고, 같은 내용을 주어 + be said/believed/thought + to부정사 형태로도 쓸 수 있습니다(He is said to be rich). 이미 일어난 일은 to have + 과거분사를 씁니다(He is thought to have left). 뉴스, 보고서, 학술 글에서 출처나 책임을 밝히지 않고 정보를 전달할 때 유용합니다.
explain.en: Impersonal passives report general opinions or rumours objectively. They appear as It is said/believed/thought/reported that + clause, or as subject + be said/believed/thought + to-infinitive (He is said to be rich). For earlier events use to have + past participle (He is thought to have left). They are useful in news, reports and academic texts when the source or responsibility is not named.
